description: Process a holds a dynaset on row 1 of T opened with dbPessimistic and calls Edit (no Update). A newly arriving process b reads rows 1, 2 and 64 through a new snapshot, dynaset, forward-only recordset and table-type Seek, each result and error recorded. Then a cancels, begins a transaction, edits and Updates row 1 without committing, and b reads the same three rows again with new cursors; finally a rolls back and b reads again. The kept file images are taken in a at each point.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
